messages:
Maya CS: Heads up — need to align on SLA visibility for Acme. They flagged renewal concerns after latency spikes last week. Can we set a short recurring check and agree on customer-facing wording for credits? cc @Vik Sales @Jordan PM
Jordan PM: Weekly 30-min sync works for me. Proposal: trigger = >=2% p95 latency breach in a calendar day -> auto ops ping + prepped customer note. Also we should ship a simple weekly 'health snapshot' doc for execs (1 page).
Anna Ops: Dashboard exists: https://redwood.app/dashboards/acme-slo — shows uptime, p50/p95, and request rate. Traces retained 30d. For credits we compute uptime_pct = (1 - downtime_seconds/elapsed_seconds)*100. Quick query (pseudo-SQL):
```
-- uptime calc, approximate
SELECT 1 - SUM(is_down_seconds)/SUM(period_seconds) AS uptime_fraction
FROM slo_checks
WHERE service = 'acme' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31';
```
Vik Sales: Need a one-paragraph exec summary we can send to procurement — sanitized, no raw percentiles. Something like: 'We met uptime SLA; transient latency affected a small subset; we applied a pro-rated credit; here's the mitigation plan.' @Jordan PM can you confirm legal-friendly phrasing for credits?
Jordan PM: Will confirm with legal. Draft blurb below — tell me if it's sendable:

"Hi team — during the window 2026-03-15 10:12–13:05 UTC we observed elevated p95 latency affecting ~3% of requests. As per the SLA, we've applied a 5% service credit for March usage and implemented a rollback + improved canary. Full evidence bundle: https://redwood.app/reports/acme/2026-03-15"

Maya CS: Paste the blurb here so I can send it. Also @Anna Ops — can you confirm the exact credit calc and ledger export to attach?
Anna Ops: Confirmed — 5% matches the uptime banding for that window. I'll attach the ledger export and the incident timeline. Also setting an alert: page when breach >1% sustained for 10m.
Maya CS: :thumbsup: Locking cadence: Fridays 11am PT for the sync? I want the snapshot to be 3 bullets: uptime this week, p95 latency trend, actions taken. I'll draft the template.
Vik Sales: Friday 11am PT works. Template sounds ideal.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout 'llm-v1.2' started 2026-03-14 09:50 UTC — may be related to cache warm-up behavior.
Maya CS: Good catch. Action items: Jordan confirm legal wording (due EOD Wed), Anna attach ledger & set alert, Maya will send initial customer email using Jordan's draft + 3-bullet snapshot. I'll create the recurring invite. Thanks all.
Maya CS: Sent initial note to customer and attached snapshot link. Marking this thread as resolved for now; will reopen if we see another breach.
